# Shop Bubble Mailers

> Bulk and custom printed bubble mailers (padded shipping envelopes) for US businesses. Kraft and white poly, every standard size from 4x6 to #7 (14.25x20), sold by the case or pallet, plain or logo printed. Quotes returned in writing within 1-2 hours. Based in Bloomington, Illinois; ships nationwide.

Contact: Info@shopbubblemailers.com · (503) 461-4788 · https://shopbubblemailers.com/contact-us/

## Key facts
- Sizes: inch sizes 4x6, 4x7, 6x9 (9x6), 7x9, 8.5x12, 10.5x15, 12x12, 12x15 and numbered sizes #000 to #7. Usable inside size is about an inch shorter than the outer size.
- Padding: 3/16 in air-bubble lining, self-seal strip.
- Finishes: kraft paper (#000 to #7), white poly (#000 to #5), metallic and recyclable paper on request.
- Pricing: plain stock from $0.12 per mailer (4x6) to $0.48 (#7) at 5,000 units; printing, material and smaller quantities change the figure. Written quotes are firm.
- Printing: 1, 2 or full color, both sides optional, digital proof before production, runs from 250 units.
- Ordering: by the case (100-500 mailers depending on size) or pallet (10,000+), mixed sizes allowed, scheduled releases for pallet programs.
